Shrooms Virtual Boy emulation core
Author: Guy Perfect and contributors, Planet Virtual Boy.
Upstream: https://git.virtual-boy.com/PVB/shrooms-vb-core
Snapshot: 31b7403252 (2026-05-21, Correction for negative affine parallax).

The core/ sources are copied unchanged from the upstream snapshot used by Lemur.
The editor's AudioNative.c adapter is separate; it is not an upstream component.
No Lemur frontend code is included. No game ROM, game sound driver, saved game
state, waveform, or music data is included in the editor distribution.

License provenance:
The author's public PVB emulator project licensing statement says:
"This project will be released under the terms of the zlib license."
https://www.virtual-boy.com/forums/t/pvb-collaborative-emulator/
(Guy Perfect, License section, checked 2026-10-05.)

That statement is the licensing basis used here. The split core repository's
snapshot does not itself contain a LICENSE file. Lemur's MIT package metadata
is not treated as a separate license grant for this core. The zlib terms are
reproduced in ZLIB.txt. Upstream authorship is retained and no ownership of
the upstream code is claimed by this editor.

The DLL is compiled with the Microsoft C runtime statically linked. The user
does not need a separately installed emulator, Python, compiler, or Ghidra.
